hooks.name: safety-wording-check
hooks.description: Check user-facing text for prohibited safety wording.

action.prompt: The user saved a web/src TypeScript file or notify/templates.py. Scan user-facing strings in the saved file for "cut", "shut off", "curtail", and "disconnect". For each hit, report the file, line, and the rule from .kiro/steering/safety.md. Suggest a replacement using "asked to reduce" or "event participation". Do not modify any file.
